LanguageData.MianMultiplayer.VersionUpdate: URGENT FROM Mian's Multiplayer Patches! PLEASE READ
LanguageData.MianMultiplayer.VersionUpdateMain:
Hi! Sorry for the interruption, but Mian's Multiplayer Patches has gotten a potential save-damaging update since the last time you've played.

If this is a new save, carry on, otherwise please continue reading.

This version has been marked as an update that could potentially affect the balance of your saves or damage them.

If you would like to know more, please go to the mod page on Steam and check the discussions for the changelog.
